claim_text: Aristotle distinguishes two kinds of desire.
rationale: Surface English 'desire' matches rich canonical Desire (Greek ὄρεξις, core tier) per §3.0 rich-preferred + concept-match per protocol Test 1 (claim about orexis-faculty). The two kinds (βούλησις/wish, ἐπιθυμία/appetite) are implicit per AF5 — passage names both via Ross's interpretation + Aristotle's Greek at 433a23-26 («ἡ γὰρ βούλησις ὄρεξις·...ἡ γὰρ ἐπιθυμία ὄρεξίς τίς ἐστιν»). Both ἐπιθυμία AND βούλησις ARE in 7,389-node compiled-index (peripheral tier; per Remediation 2026-04-28 corrected ontology context); both AF5-eligible. Aristotle is attribution-marker per §3.2 attribution-scope-not-referent + §1.5 setting-classification (not concept-referent). Source paragraph contains two genus/species muddles (Papachristou's gloss 'desire (ἐπιθυμία)' treats species-ἐπιθυμία as if it were the genus; Ross's bracketed gloss 'appetite [ὄρεξις]' treats genus-ὄρεξις as if it were the species-appetite); Aristotle's own Greek in the cited footnote 64 disambiguates with ὄρεξις as genus and βούλησις+ἐπιθυμία as species. Labels track Aristotle's-own-Greek reading (Desire = ὄρεξις the genus), not the source's surface gloss confusion. [CORRECTED 2026-04-28 per Remediation: AF5:βούλησις added (was previously framed as 'implicit-and-missing' under wrong-ontology-source assumption; βούλησις IS in compiled-index as peripheral thin slug). The two-AF5-instances (ἐπιθυμία + βούλησις) under the same claim are candidate AF5 5th-subtype 'explicit-enumeration-implicit-instances'; pattern-watch registered.]

claim_text: Mind can have no nature of its own except the capacity to receive forms.
rationale: Surface 'Mind' → Thought / Intellect (rich English compound, Greek νοῦς, core tier) per §3.0 rich-preferred + most-inclusive-compound (passage shuttles between faculty-sense at 429a10/15 'the part of the soul with which the soul knows / the thinking part of the soul' and activity-sense at 429a13/22 'how thinking can take place / thought... judges'; the dyadic compound captures both); 'nature' → Nature (rich, φύσις, core) per Aristotelian determinate-nature reading (not Essence/τὸ τί ἦν εἶναι, whatness-as-formula); 'capacity' → Potentiality / Capacity (rich compound, δύναμις, core) since 'Capacity' in compound name directly matches surface form per §3.2 English-form-preferred; 'forms' → Form (rich, εἶδος, core) per surface-variant plural→singular convention. All four rich canonicals pass six-check protocol Tests 1-3 + Checks 3-4 (concept-match holds; no scope-exceedance; no wrong-context — Aristotelian rich on Aristotle's own work, native framework). §5.4 partial-faithfulness verification: Thought/Intellect, Nature, Potentiality/Capacity grounded in quote at ~429a20-22 ('it can have no nature of its own, other than that of having a certain capacity'); Form is extractor-supplied framing — within-paragraph topic-continuation makes elaboration unusually tight (429a15-16 immediately-preceding 'capable of receiving the form of an object' + 429a27-28 same-paragraph 'the place of forms' continuation; the chapter's ongoing topic). Per §5.4 step 4, charitable-skip applied — labels include Form per paraphrase, no PL:paraphrase-distortion flag. This case sets the within-paragraph-topic-continuation precedent as the tightest end of charitable-skip-eligible elaboration spectrum. [VERIFIED 2026-04-28 per Remediation: full six-check protocol confirms rich-preferred holds across all four; thin-slug alternatives (mind, capacity, forms, nature) exist as peripheral-tier slugs but rich-preferred wins per Reading C + §3.0; no AF5 implicit referents surfaced; charitable-skip stands.]

claim_text: For a science to be reduced, every predicate appearing in its proper laws must be linked to physical predicates via some bridge law.
rationale: [CORRECTED 2026-04-28 per Remediation: original annotation was [] + AF4:Reduction + AF4:Bridge law under wrong-ontology-source assumption. All five primary-referent + load-bearing-predicate concepts ARE in 7,389-node compiled-index as peripheral-tier thin slugs.] Source location: footnote 4, pdf p. 1-2 of Fodor 1974. Six-check protocol applied per concept: Check 1 ✓ (all five present); Check 2 (no rich concept-matches at core/important tier — philosophy-of-science / Fodor-Nagel reduction space has no rich Aristotelian/Heideggerian canonical that concept-matches at correct level); Checks 3-4 moot; Check 5-6 (thin-slug labelings; 'physical predicates' compound thin slug labeled per dev-2 precedent). §1.5 primary-referent classification: reduction (claim's thesis-topic — primary referent), bridge law (linking-mechanism asserted — primary referent), predicate (load-bearing predicate — universal-quantifier subject), physical predicates (load-bearing predicate — linkage target), proper laws (load-bearing predicate — structural element). 'Science' (in ontology peripheral) excluded per §1.5: generic-placeholder for reduction's structural argument, not concept-the-claim-is-about (compare holdout patterns where generic placeholder terms not labeled). §5.4 partial-faithfulness applies: claim_text departs from quote in two ways. Two distortion mechanisms compose. (1) Terminology shift formula→predicate is a category shift, not synonymy (passage at p.1 distinguishes 'predicates of physics' from 'formulae' built from them); strict §5.4 step 4 fires on this alone. (2) Specificity addition (no physical)→physical predicates is paper-topic-continuation; would be charitable-skip-eligible alone per dev-2 precedent. Composition rule: strictest mechanism governs — mixed-mechanism cases flag when any distortion is non-charitable-skip-eligible. PL:paraphrase-distortion fires. Composition-rule reasoning is independent of ontology presence (formula vs predicate is a category-shift regardless of whether either is in ontology); kept under corrected ontology context. faithfulness=partial; no attribution-marker (no attribution-scope).
